title: Pan-Seared Vine Leaves
description: A classic British recipe featuring tender vine leaves, pan-seared to perfection.
instructions: Rinse the vine leaves and remove any stems.
Heat the velvety olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the vine leaves to the skillet and pan-sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Remove the vine leaves from the skillet and place on a plate.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.
In a small bowl, whisk together the British white wine vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Drizzle the vinegar dressing over the vine leaves.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
